title: Tomato Transformation
author: Alex Rajewski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x57fq9n

steps.title: Surface Sterilize Seeds
steps.instruction: Surface sterilize seeds using chlorine gas following the 'Seed Sterilization by Alex Rajewski' protocol.

steps.title: Sow Seeds
steps.instruction: Sow the sterilized seeds on 1/2 MSO media plates and place them in the growth room under light.

steps.title: Prepare Agrobacterium Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a 25mL broth of selective LB with Agrobacteria approximately two days before transformation and incubate for ~36 hours at 28ºC.

substeps.instruction: Select LB selection based on the Agro strain and plasmid used (e.g., kanamycin).

steps.title: Dissect Cotyledons
steps.instruction: One day before transformation (approximately 6-8 days after sowing), sterilely excise cotyledons from seedlings after they have emerged but before first true leaves appear.

substeps.instruction: Place each seedling onto the lid of a new sterile petri dish.
Cut off each cotyledon at its petiole using an autoclaved scalpel.
Cut off the tip of the cotyledon.
If the cotyledon is larger than 1cm, cut it in half.
Keep the seedling plate lid closed during dissection to prevent desiccation.

steps.title: Pre-culture Cotyledons
steps.instruction: Place excised cotyledons adaxial (top) side-down onto KCMS media plates.

substeps.instruction: Seal plates with micropore tape.
Grow for one day at 25ºC with 16-hour days.

steps.title: Prepare Agrobacterium Inoculum
steps.instruction: On the day of transformation, verify and prepare the Agrobacterium culture.

substeps.instruction: Check OD 600; optimum is 0.6-0.7.
If OD is above 1.0, dilute to below 0.5 and grow for another hour.
Transfer broth to a 50mL falcon tube and centrifuge at 8000rpm for 10 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with the same volume of liquid MS0-2% media.

steps.title: Infect Cotyledons
steps.instruction: Inoculate the explants with the prepared Agrobacterium suspension.

substeps.instruction: Transfer explants to the Falcon tube of Agrobacteria and incubate for 5 min with occasional shaking.
Pour the suspension of agrobacterium and cotyledons into an empty, sterile petri dish (or onto sterile paper towels).
Transfer cotyledons from the suspension to new KCMS plates, adaxial side-down (~20 cotyledons per plate).
Seal with micropore tape and culture for 48 hours in the dark.

steps.title: Initial Selection and Culture
steps.instruction: Transfer explants to selective 2Z media with the adaxial side up.

substeps.instruction: Ensure media contains timentin (300mg/L) to kill Agrobacterium; optionally add indole-3-butyric acid (1mg/L).
Seal with micropore tape and culture at 25ºC with 16-hour days.
Transfer explants to new 2Z media twice weekly for two weeks.

steps.title: Shoot Induction
steps.instruction: After two weeks, transfer explants to selective 1Z media (~15 per container).

substeps.instruction: Refresh on new selective 1Z media once every two weeks until shoots form (4-6 weeks).
Once shoots form, reduce density to 5 explants per container and continue refreshing as usual.

steps.title: Rooting and Propagation
steps.instruction: Excise shoots that are at least 2cm long and have at least one node and place them singly into containers with selective Rooting Media.

substeps.instruction: Allow roots to form (typically within 2 weeks for tomatoes).
For propagation of confirmed lines, transfer to nonselective Rooting Media only after the shoots have undergone at least 3 transfers onto media with antibiotics and selection.
